channel.title: The Devil Wears Prada
channel.desc: Romance 2006 Andy's dream job in the high-stakes world of New York fashion becomes a nightmare under her demanding and cruel boss. To succeed, she must transform herself, forcing her to question how much of herself she's willing to lose for her career. Meryl Streep, Anne Hathaway, Adrian Grenier, Emily Blunt, Stanley Tucci, David Frankel, Lauren Weisberger, Aline Brosh McKenna.
